rules: Work one feature at a time, in the active phase, with depends_on satisfied.
Set passes to true only after every acceptance item was verified end to end in the current session; set status to done at the same time.
Never edit or delete acceptance items to make a feature pass. If an item is wrong, explain why in PROGRESS.md and ask the owner.
New features only as split-outs of an existing one (suffix a letter, e.g. P2-LAB-01a) or with owner approval.
status: todo | in_progress | blocked | done. Blocked features name the blocker in PROGRESS.md.

features.title: Split the repository into api/, web/, infra/, data/, docs/ with history preserved
acceptance: All Django code lives under api/ (manage.py, config/, apps/); legacy root/ moved to api/config/ and every import/setting updated
Moves done with git mv in commits separate from behaviour changes; git log --follow works for a moved model file
web/ exists (Next.js app from P1-WEB-01), infra/ holds compose/nginx/Jenkinsfile, data/ contains only .gitkeep and is git-ignored
Legacy frontend/ still runs until P1-WEB-06 removes it
Root README rewritten for the monorepo (setup, make targets, docs map)

features.title: Repository hygiene and secret scan
acceptance: .env, db.sqlite3, *.log, dumps and data/ are untracked and git-ignored; .env.example and docs/operations/ENV.md document every variable
gitleaks runs over full history; findings listed in PROGRESS.md as owner actions (rotate secrets); history is NOT rewritten without owner approval
apps/reset.ps1 moved to scripts/dev/ or removed with reason

features.title: Upgrade to Django 5.2 LTS, Python 3.12, uv-managed dependencies
acceptance: pyproject.toml + uv.lock replace requirements.txt; uv run python -m django --version prints 5.2.x
All legacy tests run under pytest; failures fixed or documented with reason in PROGRESS.md
python -Wd shows no Django deprecation warnings from project code
PostgreSQL is used for dev and tests; SQLite is no longer used anywhere

features.title: Settings split and production safety checks
acceptance: config/settings/{base,dev,test,prod}.py selected by DJANGO_ENV; all secrets from env
prod settings raise ImproperlyConfigured if DEBUG is on, SECRET_KEY is a default, DB is SQLite, FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEYS or STORAGE_MASTER_KEYS are missing, or DATA_RESIDENCY_MODE is off
TIME_ZONE Africa/Nairobi, USE_TZ True; security headers (HSTS, nosniff, referrer policy) set in prod
Test proves each guard fires

features.title: API conventions: OpenAPI, problem+json, pagination, idempotency
acceptance: drf-spectacular generates api/openapi.yaml; make check fails on drift
Global exception handler returns RFC 9457 problem+json with code and request_id; no PHI in messages (test with a patient name in input)
Cursor pagination on large lists; page-number on catalogues
Idempotency-Key middleware stores key+request hash+response 24h; replay returns the same response; different body with same key returns 422

features.title: Observability baseline
acceptance: /healthz (liveness) and /readyz (DB, Redis, storage) endpoints
JSON logs with request_id; PHI scrubbing filter removes identifiers/phones/names from log records (unit tested)
Error tracker integration scrubs request bodies, cookies and headers; disabled unless DSN set and host allowed by residency guard

features.title: Dev stack and Makefile
acceptance: docker-compose.yml runs postgres, redis, minio, mailpit, api, worker, beat, web; every published port bound to 127.0.0.1
make setup && make dev brings the stack up on a clean machine; make seed loads synthetic data
All IMPLEMENTATION §5 make targets exist (stubs allowed only for later-phase targets, printing 'not yet implemented')

features.title: CI pipeline
acceptance: infra/jenkins/Jenkinsfile runs make check and make e2e on every push to main and archives reports
Coverage thresholds enforced (85% overall; 95% on access/audit/billing/payments/insurance services and policies once they exist)
gitleaks and dependency audit (pip-audit, pnpm audit) run in CI; high/critical findings fail the build

features.title: Permission catalogue, seeded roles, generated role matrix
acceptance: Permissions are code-defined per app and synced to DB by a management command; unknown codes referenced by views fail CI
Seeded roles match DESIGN §7.4, including intern, DPO and the supervisor add-on roles
make role-matrix writes docs/generated/role-matrix.csv; policy matrix test asserts every role x permission cell

features.title: Scoped, time-bound role assignments with second approver for privileged roles
acceptance: Assignments scoped to facility and optionally department/ward with valid_from/valid_to; expired assignments grant nothing (time-travel test)
Granting a privileged role creates an ApprovalRequest; a different facility admin must approve; self-approval rejected
Deactivating a user revokes all sessions immediately

features.title: Default-deny enforcement with URLconf coverage test
acceptance: DEFAULT_PERMISSION_CLASSES is the policy class; a view without a declared policy denies every request
test_every_view_has_policy walks the URLconf and fails for any view without a policy (except an explicit allowlist: login, health, webhooks with their own verification)
Legacy endpoints either have policies or are removed

features.title: Authentication: sessions, CSRF, argon2id, lockout, password policy, timeouts
acceptance: Browser auth is a Django session cookie (httpOnly, Secure in prod, SameSite=Lax) + CSRF; DRF TokenAuthentication removed for browser use and legacy tokens revoked
argon2id hashing; 12-character minimum; breached-password list check
Progressive delay after 5 failures, lock after 10, admin unlock; all audited
Idle expiry and absolute expiry enforced server-side (tests with time travel)

features.title: MFA with TOTP and recovery codes, enforced per role
acceptance: Users can enrol TOTP and receive single-use recovery codes (hashed)
Roles flagged mfa_required cannot reach any API beyond MFA enrolment until enrolled
Login from outside FACILITY_NETWORK_ALLOWLIST requires MFA for everyone
Facility setting can require MFA for all users

features.title: Shared workstation lock and PIN quick-switch
acceptance: Workstation locks after configurable idle (default 5 min); unlock needs the user's PIN
Switch user keeps the device session but every subsequent action is attributed to the new user (audit test)
PIN attempts rate-limited; PIN hashed; 5 failures force full login

features.title: Professional licences and clinical gating
acceptance: ProfessionalLicence stores regulator, registration and licence numbers, expiry, PUID, verification source
Permissions marked requires_licence are denied when the licence is missing or expired (test per clinical role)
Nightly job notifies the user and facility admin 30 days before expiry
HWR verification is a port with a fake (real adapter in P3-SHA-01)

features.title: Care-team access levels and break-glass
acceptance: check_chart_access returns none/demographics/summary/full/sensitive per DESIGN §7.7 and is used by every PHI selector
Clinician not on the care team gets summary; break-glass with reason grants full for 60 min, shows a banner, notifies medical superintendent and DPO, and appears in a review queue
Care-team membership expires 72 h after the episode closes (configurable)

features.title: Sensitive-category restriction
acceptance: Notes, diagnoses, results and documents carry a sensitivity flag
Users without clinical.record.read_sensitive see a 'hidden: sensitive' placeholder, including in timelines and exports
Break-glass does not reveal sensitive items without the permission

features.title: Maker-checker approval primitive
acceptance: Generic ApprovalRequest with payload hash, approver role, thresholds, expiry
Requester can never approve own request; payload tampering after request invalidates it
Approve/reject/expire all audited; reusable from billing, payments, pharmacy, access

features.title: Tamper-evident audit log with PHI read logging, verifier and viewer API
acceptance: AuditEvent rows hash-chained per facility per day; daily anchors written to DB and data/audit-anchors/
Chart opens, document views and patient searches (query stored as HMAC) are logged; writes logged by services
make audit-verify detects a modified or deleted row (test)
Production migration revokes UPDATE/DELETE on the audit table from the app role
Viewer API for DPO/auditor with filters; viewing the audit log is itself audited

features.title: Field-level encryption, blind indexes, key rotation
acceptance: Encrypted field type (AES-256-GCM with key IDs) used for identifiers, phones, emails, NOK contacts, consent tokens, raw payloads
Exact-match search via HMAC blind index; no plaintext identifiers in the DB (test inspects raw columns)
rotate_field_keys re-encrypts in batches and is resumable

features.title: Consents, privacy notice and data subject request skeleton
acceptance: Registration records privacy-notice acknowledgement (version, method, staff)
DataSubjectRequest register with due dates; access/portability export produces JSON (FHIR-shaped where available) + PDF summary for a patient
Retention fields (retention_until, legal_hold) exist on patient records and documents

features.title: Storage abstraction: local data/ default, S3/Contabo switch, encrypted objects
acceptance: STORAGE_BACKEND=local writes under DATA_DIR/objects; =s3 writes to the configured bucket (MinIO in dev/CI)
Document rows record backend, key, checksums, wrapped data key; object keys contain no PHI
Content served only via the authorised, audited streaming endpoint with Cache-Control: no-store
Residency guard in strict mode refuses to start with a non-allowlisted S3 endpoint (test)
Storage tests parametrised over both backends

features.title: storage_migrate and storage_verify commands
acceptance: Dry run reports what would move; real run copies, verifies ciphertext hash, flips the row; resumable after interruption
--purge-source deletes source objects only after verification in a separate run
Migration works in both directions; storage_verify detects a corrupted object

features.title: Facilities, departments, service points, wards and beds
acceptance: Facility (1:1 with warehouses.Branch) stores MFL code, FID, KEPH level, SHA contract number, KRA PIN, ODPC registration numbers, Slade code
Departments, service points (typed), wards and beds (status available/occupied/cleaning/out-of-service) with admin API
Everything PHI-related is scoped by facility

features.title: Patient registry, identifiers, next of kin, de-duplication, MRN, unidentified patients and merge
acceptance: Multiple identifiers per patient with type-specific validation; MRN gap-free per facility
Search-before-create: exact identifier/phone match plus fuzzy name + DOB scoring; creating a likely duplicate needs an explicit override reason
Estimated DOB (age in years/months) supported
Unidentified emergency patients get a temporary ID; merge into the real record via maker-checker, fully audited and reversible

features.title: Client Registry port with fake and contract test
acceptance: ClientRegistry port: search by identifier type/number returns CR ID + demographics or none
Fake implementation with deterministic synthetic records; contract test suite passes against the fake

/api/* reaches Django in dev via rewrites (and via nginx in infra config); session cookie and CSRF work without CORS

Legacy /admin, /facility, /reports views available as Next.js routes

Terminology port for DHA terminology service (fake now)
ICD-11 to MOH 705 category map seeded as draft (flagged for HRIO review) with an unmapped-codes report

features.title: Computerised order entry for lab, imaging and procedures
acceptance: Orders from the service catalogue with priority (routine/urgent/stat) and clinical indication (required)
Order sets; duplicate-order warning within a configurable window
Order lifecycle draft → placed → (awaiting payment/preauth) → ready → in progress → resulted → released → acknowledged, with cancellation reasons
Placing an order creates a provisional charge; cancelling reverses it

features.title: Laboratory workflow with validation and critical values
acceptance: Specimen collection with barcode label, receipt and rejection reasons
Result entry with units and reference ranges by sex/age; flags shown as text and icon
Two-step validation and release; amended results keep history
Critical values notify the ordering clinician and care team; acknowledgement tracked
LIS/analyser interface left as a documented port (no driver)

features.title: Imaging workflow
acceptance: Schedule, perform (radiographer), report and sign (radiologist), release
Attach report PDFs/images as documents; PACS link field (no viewer)

features.title: Prescribing and pharmacist verification
acceptance: Prescription items with generic drug, strength, form, route, dose, frequency, duration, quantity; error-prone abbreviations blocked
Allergy and duplicate-therapy checks warn at prescribing and verification
Pharmacist verification required before dispensing; intern prescriptions need co-sign

features.title: Dispensing with FEFO batches and stock ledger
acceptance: Dispense picks batches first-expiry-first-out; expired batches never dispensed
Stock decrement in a transaction with select_for_update; concurrent dispense test never drives stock negative
Partial dispense, substitution with reason, labels, counselling note; dispensing posts the charge
Every stock movement is a ledger row (no in-place quantity edits)

features.title: Controlled-drug register
acceptance: Controlled items dispensed by pharmacists only; running balance per drug and batch
Wastage requires a witness; stock adjustments need maker-checker
Register report printable per period; discrepancies create an incident

features.title: Inventory upgrade for health
acceptance: StockBatch (batch number, expiry, quantity per bin), units of measure and pack conversions on legacy products
Drug fields: generic name, strength, form, route, PPB registration, KEML flag, controlled schedule, DHA concept code
Ward/department stores, requisitions and issues, stock take with variance approval, expiry alerts
Legacy inventory tests still pass

features.title: Procedures, treatment room and nursing notes
acceptance: Procedure orders performed and documented (who, when, consumables used)
Consumables decrement stock and post charges
Nursing notes attached to the visit/admission

features.title: Admissions, bed management, transfers and bed-day charges
acceptance: Admission request → bed assignment (select_for_update; no double booking) → admitted
Bed board by ward with statuses; transfers keep history
Midnight job posts bed-day and nursing charges idempotently (re-run safe)
Elective admission deposit gate per policy; emergency admissions never gated

features.title: Ward care: rounds, kardex, MAR, observations, intake/output
acceptance: Ward round notes; nursing kardex
Medication administration record from active prescriptions: given/held/refused with reason and time; overdue doses flagged
Observation charts and fluid balance with totals

features.title: Discharge without detention
acceptance: Discharge summary (diagnoses ICD-11, procedures, medications, follow-up) signed by an authorised clinician
Discharge reasons recovered/referred/deceased/absconded/other
Outstanding balance becomes an invoice + debt agreement; no state blocks the patient leaving (test)
Bed moves to cleaning then available

features.title: Referrals in and out
acceptance: Referral out with reason, urgency, receiving facility (FID/MFL), summary, transport; PDF letter
Referral in linked to the referring facility and letter; feedback recorded

features.title: Appointments and reminders
acceptance: Clinic schedules and booking; check-in converts an appointment into a visit
SMS/email reminders contain no clinical details and respect opt-out

features.title: Service catalogue and price lists
acceptance: Service catalogue with kinds, revenue codes, SHA intervention mapping field, eTIMS item code field
Price lists per payer/scheme with effective dates; resolution order scheme → payer → cash
Price changes go through maker-checker

features.title: Automatic charge capture and reversal
acceptance: capture_charge is idempotent on (source, service); clinical events create provisional/posted charges
Responsibility split payer_amount/patient_amount with non-coverage reasons
Cancelling the source reverses the charge with an audit trail

features.title: Invoices, credit notes and PDFs
acceptance: One invoice per responsible party per visit; interim invoices for inpatients
Finalised invoices immutable; corrections via credit notes; numbering gap-free per facility per year (concurrency test)
A4 invoice PDF stored as a document

features.title: Deposits, waivers, write-offs and debt agreements
acceptance: Deposits held as unallocated credit and applied to the final invoice
Waiver thresholds A/B per DESIGN §7.9 with maker-checker
Debt agreements with instalments and statements; write-off needs finance approval

features.title: Payments core: intents, ledger, allocations, receipts, refunds, suspense
acceptance: PaymentIntent/Payment/Allocation/Receipt/Refund per PAYMENTS.md §1 with hypothesis tests for ledger invariants
Unique (provider, provider_reference); duplicate notifications never double-post (concurrency test)
Receipts numbered gap-free; reprints marked Copy; SMS/email receipts without clinical details
Refunds via maker-checker; suspense allocations via maker-checker

features.title: Cash handling with shifts and Z-reports
acceptance: Every [system] step in CASH-HANDLING-SOP.md is implemented and tested
Shift close computes expected cash and variance; out-of-tolerance variance notifies finance
Z-report PDF; SOP updated in the same commit if behaviour changed

features.title: M-Pesa (Daraja) provider adapter
acceptance: STK push initiation with idempotency; callback verified-by-query before posting
STK query fallback when no callback within 90 s; result codes mapped to cashier messages
C2B confirmation auto-matches on bill reference + amount; unmatched go to suspense
Legacy M-Pesa code removed or delegated to the adapter; sandbox run recorded as sanitised fixtures

features.title: MOH reports and KHIS export
acceptance: OPD register; MOH 705A/705B, 717, 706 monthly; 505 weekly — computed from data
CSV export always; DHIS2 dataValueSets JSON using operator-maintained DhisMapping (no hard-coded UIDs)
Fixture month produces the expected counts (E2E-14)

features.title: Clinical and service workspaces
acceptance: Workspaces: reception, triage, consultation, lab, imaging, pharmacy, wards, cashier, billing — each queue-driven with keyboard shortcuts
Every workspace page passes axe and has a Playwright happy path
Compact density toggle persists per user

features.title: Patient banner, journey rail and timeline
acceptance: Banner on every patient-scoped screen with two identifiers, allergies state, alerts, payer and verification
Journey rail reflects visit state and links completed steps
Timeline filters by type and hides sensitive items without permission

features.title: Print templates
acceptance: 80 mm receipt, A4 invoice, lab report, prescription, discharge summary, referral letter, Z-report
Print CSS tested via Playwright PDF snapshots

features.title: Phase 2 acceptance scenarios green
acceptance: E2E-01, E2E-02 (cash variant), E2E-04 (clinical part), E2E-05 (cash inpatient variant), E2E-06, E2E-13, E2E-14 pass; steps tagged [P3] are skipped with a pending marker
Phase 1 scenarios still pass
Phase 2 exit criteria in PHASE-2.md met; tag phase-2-complete pushed

features.title: Payer model and PayerGateway port with contract suite
acceptance: Payer, Scheme, Coverage, EligibilityCheck, PayerConsent, PreAuthorization, Claim(+lines, attachments, submissions), Remittance models
PayerGateway port and shared error taxonomy including SubmissionOutcomeUnknown
Contract suite runs against every adapter fake in CI

features.title: HIE client: auth, facility scoping, registries, eligibility, tariff import
acceptance: Token cache with single-flight refresh; 401 refresh-and-replay once
Registries: patient search (CR ID), facility (FID), practitioner (PUID) wired into reception, facility setup and licence verification
Eligibility, sub-benefits and interventions with flags stored as EligibilityCheck snapshots
import_sha_tariffs loads the Benefits and Tariffs spreadsheet into versioned terminology and maps services

features.title: Consent: OTP and biometric flows
acceptance: OTP path: masked contacts → send OTP → open visit; biometric path: authorise → iframe → visit with auth_guid
Pending biometric authorisations listed and rejectable
Consent token encrypted, redacted in logs and ExchangeLog (test greps logs)

features.title: Claim session lifecycle with exactly-once dispatch
acceptance: sync_claim applies only the diff (interventions, ICD-11 diagnoses, lines, attachments, doctor)
Outpatient submit, inpatient discharge (OTP or biometric), close with reason
Timeout after send yields SubmissionOutcomeUnknown and a status query before any resubmission (fault-injection test)
Status via callbacks (basic auth + allowlist) and poller; unknown states stored raw and flagged

features.title: Pre-authorisation
acceptance: Normal, elective and specialised (surgical, oncology, renal) preauth with attachments and doctor consent
Gates release services only after approval; status polling and cancel
Approved amounts enforced by the scrubber

features.title: ECCIF emergency claims with 24-hour deadline
acceptance: Emergency case opened for identified and unidentified patients; protocols with tariffs
Deadline alerts at 12 h, 20 h, 23 h; overdue report
Unidentified case updated after patient merge

features.title: PHC capitation and SHIF per diem
acceptance: UHC OP capitation visits submit zero-total claims
Per-diem LOS from serviced periods; allowance shown as unknown (not zero) when no KEPH-level rate exists
Patient-responsibility split for amounts above the allowance

features.title: FHIR mapping layer and AfyaLink bundle transport
acceptance: interop maps patients, encounters, conditions, observations, medications, coverage, claims to FHIR R4 and validates with fhir.resources
Bundle builder enforces every AfyaLink checklist rule (unique IDs, fullUrls, references, totals, periods, sequences, PHC zero, PFMS dual coverage)
Golden-fixture tests against AfyaLink reference PreAuth/Claim JSON

Runner captures redacted screenshots and request/response logs into docs/evidence/sha-uat/
Runs green in fake mode; sandbox run documented when credentials exist

Spec gaps logged; status blocked with owner action if no spec

Slade codes stored on facility and licences and used where required
